description.value:
You belong to a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities, from the Azeroth Elven Lineages table. You gain its level 1 benefit. At character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have it prepared, and you can cast it once without a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast it with any spell slots of the appropriate level you have. Your spellcasting ability for the spells of this trait is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you select the lineage).

Azeroth Elven Lineages
